prompt: The clerk spent twenty minutes helping me pick the right fish tank, so I ___ him a big thank-you before leaving.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении «tell someone thank-you» используется глагол tell, за которым сразу следует адресат (him).

prompt: The cyclist ___ to the delivery driver for ten minutes because the van was blocking the narrow bike lane.
explanation_ru: С предлогом to и указанием длительности разговора (for ten minutes) употребляется глагол speak (spoke).

prompt: Before the guests arrived, Maya and Leo ___ loudly about whether pineapple belonged on a homemade pizza.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения двустороннего обсуждения или спора на определённую тему (about...) используется talk (talked).

prompt: While filling yellow bags with washed-up plastic bottles, the volunteers ___ about their favorite sea creatures.
explanation_ru: Для непринуждённой беседы о чём-либо (about...) естественным выбором является глагол talk (talked).

prompt: Waiting for the slow elevator, the two neighbors ___ politely about the endless autumn rain.
explanation_ru: С наречием politely и предлогом about для вежливой светской беседы подходит глагол speak (spoke).

prompt: At dawn on the pier, the fisherman ___ the buyer that fresh sardines cost more after a stormy night at sea.
explanation_ru: После глагола сразу идёт прямое дополнение-адресат (the buyer) и придаточное с that, поэтому требуется told.

prompt: We ___ about the live band downstairs for a while before realizing we had both brought the exact same potato salad.
explanation_ru: Глагол talk (talked) с предлогом about описывает взаимный обмен репликами и беседу между людьми.

prompt: When the nervous patient asked to move his appointment, the receptionist kindly ___ that the dentist was very gentle.
explanation_ru: После глагола сразу идёт придаточное предложение с that без указания слушателя, поэтому используется said.

prompt: The architect ___ to the stone masons about rebuilding the fallen wall with old stones instead of modern cement.
explanation_ru: Конструкция speak to someone about something требует предлога to перед адресатом (spoke to the stone masons).

prompt: On the elevator ride down to reception, both locked-out guests ___ about how silly they felt without their key cards.
explanation_ru: Для описания совместного обсуждения ситуации (about how...) используется глагол talk (talked).

prompt: The career coach ___ the chef not to list his weekend DJ gigs on a resume for a corporate office job.
explanation_ru: В побудительной конструкции tell someone (not) to do something используется глагол told.

prompt: Two visitors were debating whether the pile of rusty bikes was modern art, so the park cleaner ___ his opinion.
explanation_ru: Хотя возможны разные глаголы, в данном наборе только said грамматически корректно сочетается с прямым дополнением без адресата (said his opinion / what he thought).

prompt: Sharing one big umbrella, they ___ about the best food stalls and guessed the band's opening song.
explanation_ru: Глагол talk (talked) с предлогом about обозначает дружескую беседу на разные темы.

prompt: After the experiment failed, Sam quietly ___ to his lab partner about whose turn it was to wash the glass beakers.
explanation_ru: Перед предлогом to с адресатом (to his lab partner) в нейтрально-деловом контексте ставится spoke.

prompt: Before the final round, one captain said the other that a wheel on their robot was loose.
answer: Before the final round, one captain told the other that a wheel on their robot was loose.
accepted_answers: Before the final round, one captain told the other that a wheel on their robot was loose.
Before the final round, one captain said to the other that a wheel on their robot was loose.
explanation_ru: После глагола say нельзя сразу ставить прямое дополнение-адресат (the other) без предлога to; лучше заменить на told.

prompt: While scanning the groceries, the cashier and the customer talked warmly about the neighborhood cat.
answer: While scanning the groceries, the cashier and the customer talked warmly about the neighborhood cat.
accepted_answers: While scanning the groceries, the cashier and the customer talked warmly about the neighborhood cat.
explanation_ru: Предложение построено верно: глагол talked с предлогом about отлично подходит для тёплой беседы.

prompt: The member called to cancel his squash court and spoke thank-you to the receptionist for waiving the late fee.
answer: The member called to cancel his squash court and said thank-you to the receptionist for waiving the late fee.
accepted_answers: The member called to cancel his squash court and said thank-you to the receptionist for waiving the late fee.
The member called to cancel his squash court and said thank you to the receptionist for waiving the late fee.
explanation_ru: Слова благодарности (thank-you) передаются через глагол say (said thank-you to...), а не speak.

prompt: Leo told to his roommate that he had seen her wearing his favorite sweater in a party photo.
answer: Leo told his roommate that he had seen her wearing his favorite sweater in a party photo.
accepted_answers: Leo told his roommate that he had seen her wearing his favorite sweater in a party photo.
Leo said to his roommate that he had seen her wearing his favorite sweater in a party photo.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell является переходным и не требует предлога to перед адресатом (told his roommate).

prompt: When the border officer asked where he was staying, the backpacker could not say the hotel's name.
answer: When the border officer asked where he was staying, the backpacker could not say the hotel's name.
accepted_answers: When the border officer asked where he was staying, the backpacker could not say the hotel's name.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: глагол say (could not say) корректно употребляется с прямым дополнением (the hotel's name) в значении «назвать/произнести».

prompt: Two classmates were saying loudly because one had deleted the shared slides an hour before class.
answer: Two classmates were talking loudly because one had deleted the shared slides an hour before class.
accepted_answers: Two classmates were talking loudly because one had deleted the shared slides an hour before class.
Two classmates were speaking loudly because one had deleted the shared slides an hour before class.
explanation_ru: Глагол say не описывает сам процесс беседы или спора между людьми; здесь нужно talking (или speaking).

prompt: The cherry blossoms opened a week early, so the friends spoke about their weekend picnic plans under the trees.
answer: The cherry blossoms opened a week early, so the friends spoke about their weekend picnic plans under the trees.
accepted_answers: The cherry blossoms opened a week early, so the friends spoke about their weekend picnic plans under the trees.
explanation_ru: Предложение грамматически правильно: spoke about описывает обсуждение планов на пикник.

prompt: The analyst thanked the director for praising his report, and the director said him he had confused him with someone else.
answer: The analyst thanked the director for praising his report, and the director told him he had confused him with someone else.
accepted_answers: The analyst thanked the director for praising his report, and the director told him he had confused him with someone else.
The analyst thanked the director for praising his report, and the director said to him he had confused him with someone else.
explanation_ru: Перед местоимением-адресатом (him) без предлога to нужно использовать told вместо said.

prompt: While a tiny puppy slept in a travel bag, the passengers quietly talked about their childhood pets.
answer: While a tiny puppy slept in a travel bag, the passengers quietly talked about their childhood pets.
accepted_answers: While a tiny puppy slept in a travel bag, the passengers quietly talked about their childhood pets.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: конструкции talked about their childhood pets не требуется исправление.

prompt: Commuters on the train platform make brief comments about the sudden summer thunderstorm soaking everyone.
options: People on the platform talked briefly about the sudden thunderstorm.
People on the platform told briefly about the sudden thunderstorm.
People on the platform said briefly about the sudden thunderstorm.
People on the platform spoke the sudden thunderstorm briefly.
explanation_ru: Только глагол talk (talked) естественно сочетается с предлогом about для краткого обмена репликами о погоде.

prompt: A reader leaves a comment under a bread recipe to thank the author for explaining how to bake without a mixer.
options: A reader left a comment to say thank you for the clear no-mixer bread recipe.
A reader left a comment to tell thank you for the clear no-mixer bread recipe.
A reader left a comment to speak thank you for the clear no-mixer bread recipe.
A reader left a comment to talk thank you for the clear no-mixer bread recipe.
explanation_ru: В выражении «сказать спасибо» (без прямого упоминания адресата сразу после глагола) используется say thank you.

prompt: Two gardeners disagree on whether tropical ferns need more misting or more sunlight in winter.
options: They talked about how to care for the tropical ferns in winter.
They said about how to care for the tropical ferns in winter.
They told about how to care for the tropical ferns in winter.
They spoke the tropical ferns care in winter.
explanation_ru: Для обсуждения темы (about how to...) используется глагол talked, тогда как say и tell не употребляются с предлогом about в такой структуре.

prompt: A father expresses his gratitude to his son for helping sort fifty boxes of old family photo albums.
options: The father said a warm thank-you to his son for helping with the photo albums.
The father told a warm thank-you to his son for helping with the photo albums.
The father spoke a warm thank-you his son for helping with the photo albums.
The father talked a warm thank-you to his son for helping with the photo albums.
explanation_ru: При наличии предлога to перед адресатом (to his son) фраза thank-you используется с глаголом say (said).

prompt: The diners politely point out to the waiter that two extra milkshakes were added to their bill by mistake.
options: They spoke politely to the waiter about the two extra milkshakes on the bill.
They told politely to the waiter about the two extra milkshakes on the bill.
They said politely the waiter about the two extra milkshakes on the bill.
They talked the waiter politely about the two extra milkshakes on the bill.
explanation_ru: Конструкция speak to someone about something (spoke politely to the waiter about...) требует глагола speak и предлога to.

prompt: Friends at a bowling alley joke and disagree about whether a ball that bounced out of the gutter counts as a strike.
options: The friends talked about whether the lucky bounce counted as a strike.
The friends said about whether the lucky bounce counted as a strike.
The friends told about whether the lucky bounce counted as a strike.
The friends spoke whether the lucky bounce counted as a strike.
explanation_ru: Глагол talked с предлогом about правильно передаёт совместное обсуждение спорного момента в игре.

prompt: A trainer shows three shoulder stretches, and the runner jokes that they look harder than running a marathon.
options: The runner told the trainer that the stretches looked harder than a marathon.
The runner said the trainer that the stretches looked harder than a marathon.
The runner spoke the trainer that the stretches looked harder than a marathon.
The runner talked the trainer that the stretches looked harder than a marathon.
explanation_ru: Когда сразу за глаголом стоит адресат без предлога (the trainer), а затем придаточное с that, нужен глагол told.

prompt: Over morning tea, the archaeologists (say / talk) about their favorite childhood foods while cleaning dusty pottery.

accepted_answers: talked
talk

explanation_ru: Для дружеской беседы на определённую тему (about their favorite childhood foods) используется глагол talk.

prompt: The cashier kindly (said / told) the father that his tickets were for tomorrow, then changed them for free.

accepted_answers: told

explanation_ru: После глагола сразу следует адресат (the father) без предлога to, поэтому выбираем told.

prompt: Minutes before the concert, the sound engineer (spoke / said) softly to the trumpet player about the loud monitor.

accepted_answers: spoke

explanation_ru: В конструкции «разговаривать с кем-либо о чём-либо» (to the trumpet player about...) используется spoke.

prompt: During the graduation ceremony, Mia (said / told) a heartfelt thank-you to all the teachers and parents.

accepted_answers: said

explanation_ru: В выражении «say thank-you to someone» перед предлогом to используется глагол say (said).

prompt: While testing a lemon battery, the grandfather (said / told) his grandson a funny story about his school science fair.

accepted_answers: told

explanation_ru: В устойчивом сочетании «tell someone a story» (рассказать историю) всегда употребляется глагол tell (told).
